question.prompt:
The value of the expression

\[\frac{(304)^5}{(29.7)(399)^4}\]

is closest to

solutions.explanation:
The choices are widely separated, so bounds can identify the closest value without calculating the large powers exactly. Let
\[
E=\frac{304^5}{29.7\cdot399^4}.
\]
All the numbers are positive. Decreasing the numerator and increasing the denominator makes the fraction smaller, so
\[
E>\frac{300^5}{30\cdot400^4}
=10\left(\frac34\right)^4
=\frac{810}{256}>3.
\]
For an upper bound, notice that \(304<399\) and \(304<11\cdot29.7=326.7\). Therefore
\[
E=\frac{304}{29.7}\left(\frac{304}{399}\right)^4<11.
\]
Thus \(3<E<11\). Every listed value below \(3\) is farther from \(E\) than \(3\) is. Also, \(E\) is less than \(8\) away from \(3\), but more than \(19\) away from \(30\). The closest listed value is \(3\), choice D.
solutions.title: Bound the expression
